sections.description: Artifacts are gear that trigger an ability when activated. These abilities may include summoning a pet , attacking an enemy mob, placing an effect on the ground, or bolstering themselves or their fellow heroes.

items.name: Battle Banner
items.description: A battle banner is a support artifact that places a circle on the ground, granting strength to heroes that walk inside it.

items.name: Blaze Bangle
items.description: A blaze bangle is an artifact that adds a status to the hero that causes their weapons to apply burning .

items.name: Blight Bangle
items.description: A blight bangle is an artifact that adds a status to the hero that causes their weapons to apply poison .

items.name: Blizzard Bangle
items.description: A blizzard bangle is an artifact that adds a status to the hero that causes their weapons to apply freezing .

items.name: Cinder Scepter
items.description: A cinder scepter is an fiery artifact that summons fire around enemies .

items.name: Conductive Quiver
items.description: A conductive quiver is an artifact that loads three electric arrows into the hero 's ranged weapon .

items.name: Corrupted Beacon
items.description: A corrupted beacon is an offensive artifact that fires a damaging purple beam when active.

items.name: Corrupted Seeds
items.description: Corrupted seeds are an artifact that places sprouts vines, inflicting poison on mobs within them.

items.name: Creeper Candle
items.description: A creeper candle is an artifact that places an explosive candle on the ground, exploding shortly after.

items.name: Death Cap Mushroom
items.description: A death cap mushroom is an artifact that grants 30% increased movement and attack speed.

items.name: Echo Ocarina
items.description: An echo ocarina is an artifact that grants a status which deflects projectiles.

items.name: Electric Bangle
items.description: An electric bangle is an artifact that applies a status to the hero that causes their weapons to deal electric damage.

items.name: Ender Fog
items.description: Ender fog is an artifact that adds the shadowcloaking status to the hero when used.

items.name: Fighter's Flute
items.description: A fighter's flute is an artifact that grants a status which greatly increases the chance of critical hits .

items.name: Fighting Fungus
items.description: The fighting fungus is an artifact which increases attack speed by 100%.

items.name: Firework Arrow
items.description: A firework arrow is an offensive artifact that loads an explosive firework into your ranged weapon .

items.name: Flaming Quiver
items.description: A flaming quiver is an artifact that loads three flaming arrows into the hero 's ranged weapon .

items.name: Freezing Quiver
items.description: A freezing quiver is an artifact that loads three icy arrows into the hero 's ranged weapon .

items.name: Grindstone
items.description: A grindstone is an artifact that increases damage.

items.name: Honey Dipper
items.description: A honey dipper is an artifact that drops honey and bees on the ground.

items.name: Humbling Horn
items.description: A humbling horn is an artifact . Once used, it pushes mobs back from the player and slows them briefly. It is very similar to the Wind Horn from the original Minecraft Dungeons game.

items.name: Lightning Rod
items.description: A lightning rod is an electric artifact that summons lightning around enemies .

items.name: Picnic Basket
items.description: A picnic basket is a supportive artifact that summons food when placed.

items.name: Pouch of Ember
items.description: A pouch of ember is a fiery artifact that releases an explosive burst of fire.

items.name: Pouch of Frost
items.description: A pouch of frost is an icy artifact that releases an explosive burst of ice.
effects: Fire attacks deal 10% more damage

items.name: Pouch of Poison
items.description: A pouch of poison is an poison artifact that releases an explosive burst of poison.

items.name: Pouch of Thunder
items.description: A pouch of thunder is an electric artifact that releases an explosive burst of lightning.

items.name: Powershaker
items.description: A powershaker is an artifact that imbues the user with a status causing their attacks to release explosions on mobs . Note: there is a bug with this one where canceling the shaking animation will make it flash red as it it were still on cooldown. You can resolve this by re-equipping it.

items.name: Redstone Mine Launcher
items.description: A redstone mine launcher is an artifact that deploys redstone mines on the ground which explode after a short delay.

items.name: Soul Harvester
items.description: A soul harvester is an artifact that releases a burst of souls , dealing damage in a large radius.

items.name: Tempo Truffle
items.description: A tempo truffle is an artifact that grants the hero a movement speed boost.

items.name: Totem of Casting
items.description: A totem of casting is an artifact that places an area of effect, granting heroes within it reduced artifact cooldown times.

items.name: Totem of Regeneration
items.description: The totem of regeneration is an artifact that, when placed, creates a circle of healing for allies .

items.name: Totem of Shielding
items.description: The totem of shielding is an artifact that, when placed, spawns a shield that protects against projectiles.

items.name: Turtle Master's Mandolin
items.description: The turtle master's mandolin is a musical artifact that provides a defensive boost to all nearby allies and companions .

items.name: Venomous Quiver
items.description: A venomous quiver is an artifact that loads three poisonous arrows into the hero 's ranged weapon .

items.name: Warding Chimes
items.description: Warding chimes are an artifact that make the hero temporarily impervious to damage.

items.name: Warrior Drums
items.description: Warrior drums are an artifact that grants the hero a status effect that increases critical hit damage for a few seconds.

items.name: Winter Staff
items.description: A winter staff is an icy artifact that summons a blizzard toward enemies .
effects: Reduces artifact cooldown by 20%. Frost attacks deal 15% more damage.

items.name: Witch Brew
items.description: A witch brew is a throwable artifact that creates a lingering purple cloud where it lands. Enemies that walk into or are hit by this cloud are coated in the brew, taking 1.5x damage and dealing 0.5x damage for the duration of the effect. The effect has a separate duration from the lingering cloud, which only ticks down until the enemy has left the cloud, or until the cloud has disappeared.
